convert_hunyuandit_checkpoint: convert a HunyuanDiT PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace Diffusers format using the CLI script
remap_attention_weights: remap HunyuanDiT attention layer weights from Wqkv format to separate to_q, to_k, to_v projections
remap_embedder_weights: remap HunyuanDiT embedder weights including t_embedder, x_embedder, mlp_t5, and extra_embedder to Diffusers naming
swap_norm_layers: swap norm2 and norm3 layer weights in HunyuanDiT transformer blocks for Diffusers compatibility
generate_image_with_pipeline: generate an image using the converted HunyuanDiTPipeline with a Chinese or English text prompt
